fact: CEPICI says it launched the online company-creation service E-ENTREPRISE in October 2018, via the 225invest.ci portal.
CEPICI states that firms can be created online through the E-Entreprise platform on the 225Invest portal, where creators complete their formalities.

CEPICI states that the Identifiant Unique (IDU), operational since 2018, is now the one number a firm needs with every administration, registering it with the commercial register, the tax authority and the social security fund (CNPS).

CEPICI's director general says in an interview that the average time to create a company online was 2.4 days at mid-July 2026, with more than 4,200 RCCM transmitted online, though full dematerialisation is still being finalised.
system: CEPICI platform (Guichet Unique de Formalites d'Entreprise)

fact: CEPICI launched the Annuaire IDU on 9 July 2025, a directory of registered firms keyed on a single 14-character Identifiant Unique that merges the RCCM, tax (DFE) and CNPS social security numbers issued at company creation.
